# TamizhTech Robotics Company

> TamizhTech Robotics Company is a technology company headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. The Tamizh Robotics Club (TRC) was established in 2021; TamizhTech Robotics Company was incorporated in 2024. We specialize in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Drone Technology, IoT, Embedded Systems, and Industrial Automation. We design and manufacture competition robotics kits, deliver custom industrial automation projects (AGVs, AMRs, vision AI), and run structured STEM/robotics education through ThiranOli Academy — taught in Tamil, English, and Hindi.
